title: Marvell raises 2028 revenue forecast on strong AI data center demand
source_used: The Economic Times (Reuters); The Motley Fool
key_facts: Marvell Technology raised its fiscal 2028 (year ending 31 Jan 2028) revenue outlook to about $20 billion.
The previous guidance, given in August, was $18 billion.
Reuters: shares rose nearly 9% in early trading; Motley Fool: closed up 5.81% at $287.01.
Investor day on 6 Oct 2026 also set a fiscal 2031 target of $70-90 billion in sales and EPS of $30 or more.
Marvell makes custom AI chips and data center networking gear.
Reuters synopsis says the stock has tripled this year.
Earlier this year Nvidia invested $2 billion in Marvell.
quote_evidence: The company raised its revenue outlook for its 2028 fiscal year (FY), ended Jan. 31, 2028, to $20 billion. (Motley Fool)
Previously, Marvell had projected $18 billion in revenue in August. (Reuters via Economic Times)
why_it_matters_hint: Guidance points to continued strong demand for AI data center chips.
notes: Reuters original blocked (401); read Reuters synopsis on Economic Times and full Motley Fool article. Reuters synopsis wording on analyst expectations was unclear and is not used.
